# E5b — which instructions the action-expert kernels wait on

**Generated by `bench/analyze_e5b.py` from the committed ncu CSVs.** The stall -> instruction-class mapping is `docs/03_instruction_level_analysis.md` §7, reproduced verbatim in the script; nothing here invents a cause.

Two rules from §7 that the tables below follow:

* **`selected` is not a stall to fix.** It means the warp was ready and another was issued — ample warp-level parallelism. It is excluded from the "waiting" denominator and shown separately, because counting it makes a healthy kernel look stalled.
* **A reason §7 does not name is reported under its exported name**, with its cause left open. `imc_miss` is the one that matters here: C1 found the eager action expert `imc_miss`-limited in all three LeRobot models, and §7 has no entry for it.

Thresholds are §7's: long scoreboard >= 60 % means memory-latency bound; math pipe throttle > 10 % means compute bound.

### groot_n17 / best / ae_total — `Kernel2`

2563.7 µs, SM throughput 50.6 %. **neither threshold met; largest wait is wait at 24.6 %**

| stall reason | % of waiting | % of all | class | in §7 | cause |
|---|---:|---:|---|---|---|
| `wait` | 24.6 | 22.4 | ALU/XU | yes | fixed-latency operation in flight (transcendental, integer divide, FP64), DEPBAR |
| `mio_throttle` | 18.3 | 16.7 | LSU | yes | LSU issue queue full: too many loads or stores in flight |
| `barrier` | 16.5 | 15.0 | control | yes | BAR.SYNC / WARPSYNC: waiting for the other warps — load imbalance, or too few warps to hide it |
| `long_scoreboard` | 15.6 | 14.2 | LSU | yes | global-memory load (LDG / LD.E) issued; the dependent instruction cannot fire until the data returns |
| `selected` | — (ready, not waiting) | 9.1 | — | yes | the warp was READY and another was issued — a sign of ample warp-level parallelism, NOT a problem (§7) |
| `math_pipe_throttle` | 8.9 | 8.1 | FMA | yes | FMA / tensor-core pipe full: back-pressure from compute |
| `lg_throttle` | 6.9 | 6.3 | LSU | yes | load/store address calculation, or a shared-memory bank conflict |
| `short_scoreboard` | 6.4 | 5.8 | LSU/XU | yes | shared-memory load (LDS), constant-cache miss, SHFL, MUFU |
| `imc_miss` | 1.2 | 1.1 | ? | no | cause not documented in docs/03 §7 — reported under its exported name rather than given a guessed cause |
